dialogues.speaker: Miyazaki Saburou
dialogues.text: Earlier, when I was gathering materials, I heard that there were some ore veins nearby that even contained some Magical Crystal Ore. Those are some sort of mutation of ordinary Crystal Ore, though they are very difficult to process...

dialogues.speaker: Miyazaki Saburou
dialogues.text: If I remember right, they should be around here. I've marked them on your map now, so if you do need them, go have a look.
